mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies near the Verona Public Library with a Waning Gibbous moon. The overnight low will drop to 49 degrees with no rain in the forecast. Please note that the ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

In city news, the engineering reports for the City of Verona remain ongoing through our partners at AECOM. Additionally, the Wisconsin Department of Transportation is seeking community feedback on the US 18/151 Corridor Study with meetings scheduled for November 18 and 19.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Today you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, we have yoga at Insight Wellness, pizza at Lake Lou-ee, and trivia night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, don't miss the Main Street Trick or Treat on October 29.
On October 22, a vehicle crash occurred involving a Metro Bus on West Verona Avenue, resulting in a citation for failure to yield the right of way.
While today's flavor of Chocolate Caramel Twist has come to an end, you can look forward to tomorrow's flavor, which is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store will open tomorrow at 10:00 AM.
